'''Shadows of the Empire''' names two cancelled Decipher expansions: a 1996–97 full set listed in ''[[The Duelist]]'', and a 2000 ~20-card mini-expansion (CardGuide #33).

== 1996–97 expansion ==

''The Duelist'' #13 (October 1996) dated a ''Shadows of the Empire'' expansion to late December or January, after ''[[Hoth Limited|The Empire Strikes Back: Hoth]]''.<ref name="duelist13news" /> Issue 14 (December 1996) said the expansion's future was uncertain. Some cards planned for ''Shadows'' would instead appear in a ''[[Special Edition]]'' expansion projected for June 1997.<ref name="duelist14news" /> Issue 15 (February 1997) reported that plans for a ''Shadows of the Empire'' expansion had been canceled.<ref name="duelist15news" />

The cancelled expansion shares its name with Lucasfilm's 1996 [[Shadows of the Empire (multimedia)|multimedia project]], whose story is Black Sun under [[Prince Xizor]] and swoop gangs on Tatooine. [[Special Edition]] printed {{CardLink|Makurth}}. Its lore names bodyguards for Black Sun. {{CardLink|Flare-S Racing Swoop}} is a 600 kph racing swoop. {{CardLink|Swoop Mercenary}} lore names swoop gangs on Tatooine.

== 2000 mini-expansion ==

The later product was scheduled for August 2000 as a mini-expansion of about 20 cards based on the novel of the same name (CardGuide #33). The novel is set between ''The Empire Strikes Back'' and ''Return of the Jedi''. Decipher placed that story arc between [[Cloud City Limited]] and [[Jabba's Palace Limited]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 March 2005)</ref>

The Death Star II starter-deck rulebook advertised it as the next expansion, featuring Prince Xizor, Dash Rendar, their starships, and photo-realistic art.<ref name="ds2rb">Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook advertisement, reproduced on [[Cancelled Expansions]].</ref> Many of those card concepts shipped instead as unique premiums in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] (including [[Prince Xizor]], [[Dash Rendar]], [[Guri]], [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]], [[Outrider]], [[Stinger]], and [[Virago]]).<ref name="encyc" />

No retail packaging was released.
